_help: Board settings. prop_markets: which player stats to pull (each costs 1 Odds API credit per game). weekly_credits: 'auto' gives every football week (Tue-Mon) the same share of your monthly credits ((quota - reserve) x 7/31), or set a number; game lines (2 credits per update) come out of it first and props get the rest. Unused credits roll from weekday updates to the weekend. prop_credits_per_run: optional cap per update. credit_reserve: credits always kept so game lines never stop. schedule must match .github/workflows/update.yml (UTC; weekday 0=Mon; weight = share of the week's prop credits).
